name: TC-DA — Student withdraws a submitted DA application via the kebab menu

steps.name: Log in as the student and open Direct Apply home
Expect "toBeVisible" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Expect "toHaveCount" getByRole('heading', { name: 'Direct Apply', exact: true }).or(getByRole('heading', { name: 'What is Direct Apply?', exact: true }))
Open the submitted application card kebab menu and withdraw

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Christian Heritage College', exact: true }) }).filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Status', exact: true }) }).last()

Click locator('div').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Christian Heritage College', exact: true }) }).filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Status', exact: true }) }).last().locator('[data-testid="header-menu"]')
Verify the application card reflects the Withdrawn status

Expect "toBeVisible" locator('div').filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Christian Heritage College', exact: true }) }).filter({ has: getByRole('heading', { name: 'Status', exact: true }) }).last().getByText('Withdrawn', { exact: true })
